title: Artifact
description: One outside source kept in Maia City's artifact library (Artifacts/items/<id>/artifact.json). Checked by `bun Artifacts/artifacts.js check`. Word and paragraph limits use the x-maxWords and x-maxParagraphs keywords, which the checker reads.

id.description: The folder's name: kebab-case, short, unique.

src.description: The link, as it can be opened.

type.description: What kind of source: a YouTube video, another video, a podcast episode, an X post, another social media post (Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, Reddit…), a blog post, a news or magazine article, a website or page, a Wikipedia article, a research paper, a book, a code repository, or other.

title.description: Short and compact, in our words, without the site's or channel's name.

description.description: What it is and why it matters to us, at most 200 words, plain text.

summary.description: Its substance in at most three paragraphs, one string each; Markdown allowed (bold, lists).

category.description: The one shelf it stands on; the library filters by it.

author.description: Who made it: a person, or where none is named, the publisher.

published.description: When it was published, as far as known.

length.description: Its length as read: 28 min, 12 pages, 2,400 words.

origin.description: human: a link someone brought (added by them); agent: one avenMAIA found in its own research (sourced by avenMAIA).

url.description: The source's own image (YouTube thumbnail, og:image); shown on the published site.

file.description: Its copy on this machine (git-ignored), when fetched.
The extract, verbatim, on this machine only (git-ignored: it is the author's work, not ours).

how.description: How it was extracted: pasted by Samuel, yt-dlp subtitles, the page's text…

usedIn.description: Repository files that draw on it, e.g. Compass/worldbuilding/systems/the-tribe.md.

intent.description: The intent it was added under.
